model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488, Neurofilament-H (SMI-32) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D visualization of both regenerating/reshaping axons and mature/residual axonal tracts in a dense, lipid-rich ~15 mm spinal cord segment. uDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing method for long CNS tracts (T06 tier), offering strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by uDISCO, so we use immunolabeling: β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels all neuronal processes including nascent/regenerating fibers, while non-phosphorylated neurofilament-H (recognized by SMI-32 antibody, mapped to “Neurofilament” under structural neuron markers) specifically highlights mature, stable axons—enabling direct comparison of regeneration vs. survival. Both primary antibodies are well-validated in cleared spinal cord and compatible with uDISCO’s organic solvent workflow. Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are highly photostable and uDISCO-compatible.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spinal cord autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, e.g., BioLegend 801201, 1:500) and anti-Neurofilament-H (SMI-32, e.g., BioLegend 801601, 1:500) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-Labeling Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, ≥99.8%).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour or until imaging)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-c-Fos + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Npas4 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires distinguishing two immediate early gene (IEG)-expressing neuronal subpopulations (c-Fos and Npas4) across the entire adult mouse brain at single-cell resolution. Both c-Fos and Npas4 are nuclear IEG markers induced by neuronal activation and are not reliably captured by pan-neuronal or structural markers. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for whole adult mouse brains (T04 tier), offering strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488 and 568—both explicitly listed as compatible fluorophores for iDISCO+. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here since labeling relies on immunostaining with bright, photostable synthetic dyes. The method provides high clearing power for dense, lipid-rich tissue like the intact brain while enabling whole-organ imaging with minimal background.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Fixation and Preparation  
1.1 Perfusion-fixation with ice-cold 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS under deep anesthesia. Post-fixation of dissected whole brain in 4% PFA at 4 ℃ for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment removal)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) in 100% methanol. Prepare by mixing 1 volume of 30% H₂O₂ with 5 volumes of methanol immediately before use. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Permeabilization and Blocking  
5.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 20% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum, and 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Primary Antibody Staining  
6.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% donkey serum): rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:500) and goat anti-Npas4 (1:300). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle shaking)  

7 Wash  
7.1 Wash with PBST (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Repeat wash with fresh PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.3 Final wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Secondary Antibody Staining  
8.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer: donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500). Protect from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle shaking)  

9 Post-Staining Wash  
9.1 Wash with PBST for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
9.2 Repeat wash with fresh PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
9.3 Final wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Transfer to fresh 100% DBE for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  

13 Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Mount cleared brain in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE. Seal to prevent evaporation. Ready for light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 568, DiI]  
**Justification:** The goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of neuronal somata, dendrites, and axons across the entire adult mouse brain—a large, lipid-rich tissue demanding strong delipidation and deep labeling penetration. uDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing method for whole adult mouse brains, offering rapid, high-clearing power, excellent compatibility with lipophilic tracers (e.g., DiI), and robust preservation of Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in uDISCO, so we use immunolabeling with Alexa Fluor–conjugated secondary antibodies against pan-neuronal structural markers: NeuN for neuronal nuclei/somata, MAP2 for dendrites, and DiI (applied post-fixation via crystal insertion or pressure injection) for long-range axonal tracing. This combination ensures comprehensive visualization of all three target structures with high signal-to-background and compatibility with uDISCO’s organic solvent environment.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if endogenous pigment present)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Immunolabeling (perform after rehydration if using aqueous primary antibodies; here adapted for methanol-compatible protocol)  
3.1 Rehydration: sequential incubation in 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each at RT.  
3.2 Permeabilization and blocking: incubation with PBST (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100) + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.3 Primary antibody incubation: anti-NeuN (1:500) and anti-MAP2 (1:500) in PBST + 5% serum + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)  
3.4 Washing: 5 changes of PBST over 3 days (each wash: 12–16 hours at RT, gentle shaking)  
3.5 Secondary antibody incubation: Alexa Fluor 647 donkey anti-mouse (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568 donkey anti-rabbit (1:500) in PBST + 5% serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)  
3.6 Washing: 5 changes of PBST over 3 days (each wash: 12–16 hours at RT, gentle shaking)  

4 DiI labeling (can be performed pre- or post-immunostaining; here integrated post-primary but before dehydration restart)  
4.1 Microinjection or crystal placement of DiI into regions of interest under stereomicroscope, followed by incubation in PBST at 37 ℃ for 14 days to allow diffusion.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 14 days)  
4.2 Post-DiI washing: 3 changes of PBST over 2 days.(Temperature: RT, Time: 16 hours per wash)  

5 Re-dehydration (post-labeling)  
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

6 Delipidation  
6.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Store cleared brain immersed in DBE in glass vials protected from light at RT.  
8.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy; equilibrate for 30 minutes before acquisition.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D reconstruction of regenerating and spared axonal tracts across a 15-mm-long, lipid-rich spinal cord segment. uDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing method for long CNS tracts (tier T06), offering strong delipidation, deep antibody/dye penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in uDISCO, so we use immunolabeling with anti–β-III Tubulin (a pan-axonal marker labeling all axons, including regenerating fibers) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488, and co-staining with IB4 lectin (binds microglia and vasculature, providing structural context around the lesion) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647—both fluorophores are compatible with uDISCO. This dual-labeling strategy enables discrimination of axonal continuity, trajectory relative to the lesion core, and interaction with reactive glial/vascular scaffolds.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spinal cord pigmentation)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti–β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) mouse monoclonal antibody (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)  

6 Washing after Primary  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Lectin Co-staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated donkey anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated IB4 (10 µg/mL) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)  

8 Washing after Secondary/Lectin  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until light-sheet or confocal imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS + Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The original CUBIC protocol failed due to insufficient delipidation and poor penetration in dense adult mouse whole brain, leading to heterogeneous transparency and weak deep-tissue signal. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for T04_WHOLE_MOUSE_BRAIN_5_12MM samples, offering strong delipidation, high refractive index matching, and excellent antibody penetration—critical for detecting nuclear immediate early gene (IEG) markers like C-Fos and Npas4 across the entire brain. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in iDISCO+, so direct immunolabeling with compatible Alexa Fluor dyes (488 and 647) is required. Both Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are explicitly compatible with iDISCO+, enabling robust dual-channel detection of two IEG-defined activated neuron subpopulations without cross-talk or signal loss. This strategy preserves single-cell resolution and enables accurate 3D spatial mapping and comparative circuit analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal goat serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin + 1% (wt/vol) BSA (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-C-Fos (e.g., rabbit monoclonal, 1:500) and anti-Npas4 (e.g., goat polyclonal, 1:250) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 three more times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-goat IgG (1:500) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 three more times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol : benzyl benzoate (BABB, 1:2 ratio).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) BABB.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer cleared brain into glass vial filled with fresh BABB and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in BABB-compatible imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy, ensuring full immersion in BABB during acquisition.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-c-Fos primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody, anti-NeuN primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires mapping behaviorally activated neurons at single-cell resolution across the entire adult mouse brain. Immediate early genes (IEGs) such as c-Fos are gold-standard markers for neuronal activation, while NeuN provides pan-neuronal context to distinguish activated neurons within the total neuronal population. iDISCO+ is an established, high-clearing-power solvent-based method optimized for whole adult mouse brains (~10 mm scale), enabling deep antibody penetration and efficient lipid removal. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, it is fully compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 dyes, which exhibit excellent signal retention and minimal bleaching during dehydration and delipidation. This combination ensures specific labeling of activated neurons (c-Fos+) within the neuronal compartment (NeuN+), with high signal-to-background and compatibility with light-sheet microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching (optional but recommended for IEGs)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT containing 20% (vol/vol) DMSO and 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBT + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS) + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (PBT + 5% NGS + 0.2% heparin): anti-c-Fos (1:500) and anti-NeuN (1:1000).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% heparin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat washing step 6.1 five more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer: Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rabbit (1:500, for c-Fos) and Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-mouse (1:500, for NeuN).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% heparin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat washing step 8.1 five more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in airtight glass vial wrapped in aluminum foil at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity preservation of long-range axonal continuity across a 15-mm spinal cord segment containing a mechanically fragile injury core. Solvent-based clearing methods like uDISCO offer superior lipid removal and deep antibody penetration in dense CNS tissue while maintaining structural integrity better than electrophoretic approaches (which caused fragmentation). uDISCO is established for long CNS tracts (>10 mm), provides strong clearing power without hydrogel embedding, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 568/647—ideal for dual-color labeling of axons (β-III Tubulin/TUJ1) and dendrites/soma (MAP2) to distinguish regenerating fibers from residual neuronal architecture. Endogenous FPs are avoided due to quenching risk; instead, robust immunolabeling with far-red/near-IR fluorophores ensures signal stability through dehydration and high-RI matching.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if endogenous pigments present)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and anti-MAP2 (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 five times, total wash time: 6 hours  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 five times, total wash time: 6 hours  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, MBP+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing method for long CNS segments (15–80 mm), offering strong delipidation power, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes—critical for visualizing both regenerating/immature axons (via β-III Tubulin/TUJ1) and mature/ensheathed axons (via myelin basic protein, MBP). It preserves 3D geometry sufficiently for spatial trajectory analysis across injury zones while enabling high-resolution light-sheet imaging. Endogenous FPs are quenched in uDISCO, so primary antibodies conjugated to stable Alexa Fluor dyes (488 and 647) are used for robust dual-channel labeling without signal loss. This strategy directly addresses the need to distinguish regenerative fibers (TUJ1+) from preserved mature tracts (MBP+) around the lesion core.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and anti-MBP (1:250) in PBST + 5% normal donkey serum + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat PBST wash.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat PBST wash.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500) in PBST + 5% normal donkey serum + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
8.2 Repeat PBST wash.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
8.3 Repeat PBST wash.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

12 Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE; orient spinal cord longitudinally for optimal fiber trajectory visualization.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, MBP+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D visualization of long-range corticospinal projections across the entire CNS (≈40 mm), demanding a clearing method with strong delipidation power, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with robust synthetic fluorophores. uDISCO is established for whole-body and long CNS samples, provides high refractive index matching (>1.52), and preserves Alexa Fluor dyes effectively. Endogenous FPs are quenched in solvent-based methods, so we use immunolabeling: β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels all neuronal axons (including corticospinal tract fibers) with Alexa Fluor 488 for green-channel projection tracing; MBP (myelin basic protein) with Alexa Fluor 647 labels myelinated tracts in the red/far-red channel to visualize endogenous white matter architecture and assess spatial relationships between labeled projections and host myelinated pathways. This dual-channel strategy enables continuous tracking of projection continuity, trajectory, and target innervation relative to native myelin scaffolds.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for CNS pigmentation)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, e.g., BioLegend 801201, 1:500) and anti-MBP (e.g., Abcam ab7349, 1:300) diluted in PBST + 5% DMSO + 5% NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat 6.1 two more times (total 3 washes, each 24 hours).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500) diluted in PBST + 5% DMSO + 5% NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, protected from light)  

8 Post-labeling Washing  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat 8.1 two more times (total 3 washes, each 24 hours).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, MBP + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity visualization of long-range axonal projections from cortex to spinal cord and their spatial relationship with white matter tracts. uDISCO is ideal for large, lipid-rich CNS samples (35–40 mm) due to its strong delipidation power, compatibility with deep antibody penetration, and high refractive index matching enabling whole-mount light-sheet imaging. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in solvent-based methods, so we use robust immunolabeling: β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels all neuronal processes (including long-range projections), while myelin basic protein (MBP) marks white matter pathways to assess trajectory fidelity and branching context. Alexa Fluor 647 and 488 are highly compatible with uDISCO, resistant to organic solvents, and spectrally separable for dual-channel 3D reconstruction.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 10% (wt/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, e.g., BioLegend 801201, 1:500) and anti-MBP (e.g., Abcam ab7349, 1:250) diluted in PBT + 5% normal donkey serum + 5% DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five more times (total 6 washes over 24 hours).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in PBT + 5% normal donkey serum + 5% DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-Labeling Washing  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five more times (total 6 washes over 24 hours).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, ≥99.8%).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in sealed, light-protected container.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE; store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite for short-term storage <1 month)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, DiI]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity visualization of long-range corticospinal projections across a 35–40 mm intact CNS, demanding deep labeling penetration, strong lipid removal for transparency in dense white matter tracts, and compatibility with deep-tissue imaging. uDISCO is established for whole-body and long CNS samples, provides high refractive index matching (~1.52), excellent clearing of myelinated regions, and preserves lipophilic dye signals like DiI—ideal for tracing axonal projections over centimeters. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in solvent-based methods, so we avoid GFP/YFP reporters. Instead, we combine: (1) DiI—a carbocyanine lipophilic tracer that diffuses along membranes to label entire projection pathways when applied to cortical injection sites pre-fixation or via post-fixation incubation—and (2) immunostaining against β-III Tubulin (TUJ1), a pan-neuronal axonal marker labeled with Alexa Fluor 647, which is compatible with uDISCO and reveals the global axonal scaffold to contextualize specific DiI-labeled projections. This dual-labeling strategy enables discrimination of target-specific long-range fibers (DiI) from background endogenous axons (TUJ1-AF647).

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation and Bleaching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining (for β-III Tubulin)  
3.1 Rehydration: sequential incubation in 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 30 min each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per step)  
3.2 Permeabilization and blocking: incubation with PBST (PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100) + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, e.g., BioLegend 801201) diluted 1:500 in PBST + 5% serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle shaking)  

4 Wash  
4.1 Incubation with PBST (PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 buffer changes)  

5 Secondary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated donkey anti-mouse IgG (H+L) diluted 1:500 in PBST + 5% serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST (PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 buffer changes)  

7 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
7.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 DiI Labeling (if not pre-applied; optional post-clearing enhancement)  
8.1 Incubation with 10 µM DiI in 100% methanol (prepared fresh from 1 mM stock in DMSO).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 14 days with gentle shaking)  

9 Wash (post-DiI)  
9.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

10 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, ≥99.8%).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

11 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
11.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in light-protected glass vial at RT.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)  
11.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet microscopy (e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope or similar) for 3D acquisition.(Temperature: RT, Time: As needed for imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, DiI]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires long-range axonal tracing across the entire CNS (35–40 mm) with preservation of both specific projection fibers and the global axonal scaffold. uDISCO is established for whole-body and long-tube CNS clearing, offering high refractive index matching, strong delipidation for deep penetration, and compatibility with lipophilic tracers (e.g., DiI) and far-red fluorophores (e.g., Alexa Fluor 647). Endogenous FPs are quenched in solvent-based methods, so we avoid GFP/YFP and instead use DiI (injected pre-fixation or post-fixed via diffusion) for anterograde/retrograde labeling of target projections, and pan-axonal β-III Tubulin immunostaining with Alexa Fluor 647 to visualize the endogenous fiber network as spatial reference. Both labels are uDISCO-compatible and resistant to organic solvents. The protocol includes controlled dehydration, bleaching to reduce autofluorescence (critical for spinal cord), and gradual RI matching to minimize shrinkage.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Bleaching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) primary antibody diluted 1:500 in antibody dilution buffer (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% normal donkey serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution every 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated donkey anti-mouse IgG (or appropriate host) diluted 1:300 in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution every 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash)  

9 DiI Application (if not pre-injected)  
9.1 Incubation with 10 µM DiI in PBS + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide, applied directly to cortical injection site or immersed for diffuse labeling.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 14 days, protected from light)  

10 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
10.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Repeat step 11.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol (TBA).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) TBA.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.4 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥24 hours)  

13 Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Mount sample in glass capillary or chamber filled with DBE, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 + Alexa Fluor 488, 4G8 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for whole adult mouse brains (5–12 mm), offering strong delipidation power essential for dense amyloid-laden tissue in 5XFAD models, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488/647—both validated as compatible fluorophores in iDISCO+. Using two conformationally distinct anti-Aβ antibodies (6E10 targeting Aβ₁–₁₆ and 4G8 targeting Aβ₁₇–₂₄) labeled with spectrally separable dyes enables dual-channel validation of amyloid plaques, minimizing false positives from autofluorescence or non-specific deposits. Endogenous fluorescence is quenched in iDISCO+, but this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on exogenous immunostaining. The method preserves 3D plaque morphology sufficiently for quantitative volumetric analysis while enabling whole-brain light-sheet imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for AD brain to reduce lipofuscin autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared fresh: 1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: 6E10 (mouse monoclonal, 1:500) and 4G8 (mouse monoclonal, 1:500) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial suitable for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store cleared brain immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Mount in glass capillary or imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for adult mouse brain and tumor tissue, offering strong delipidation power for dense samples (~8 mm scale), excellent preservation of vascular architecture, and compatibility with both Alexa Fluor dyes and lectin-based vascular labeling. It preserves fluorescence of Alexa Fluor 488/647 and supports deep antibody penetration—critical for visualizing intact blood-brain barrier (via Claudin-5) and pan-vascular networks (via Lectin). Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, ScaleS), FDISCO achieves faster and more complete clearing in lipid-rich tumor-brain interfaces while minimizing light scattering. Lectin labels perfused vasculature broadly (including tumor neovasculature), and Claudin-5 specifically marks endothelial tight junctions, enabling direct spatial comparison of vascular continuity and barrier integrity between tumor core, margin, and normal parenchyma.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Permeabilization and Blocking  
1.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Vascular and Barrier Labeling  
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody mix: anti-Claudin-5 (1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.2 Washing with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS (3 changes, 24 hours total).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat IgG, 1:500) and Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated *Lycopersicon esculentum* lectin, 1:100) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.4 Washing with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS (3 changes, 24 hours total).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh ethyl cinnamate (ECi) for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)  
6.2 Mount sample in ECi-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy, ensuring no air bubbles.(Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 + Alexa Fluor 488, 4G8 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for whole adult mouse brains (5–12 mm scale) with high lipid content and dense pathology like Aβ plaques. It enables deep antibody penetration, strong delipidation for high transparency, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488 and 568—both robust synthetic fluorophores that resist quenching during organic solvent processing. Using two well-validated anti-Aβ monoclonal antibodies (6E10 targeting Aβ<sub>1–16</sub>, 4G8 targeting Aβ<sub>17–24</sub>) labeled with spectrally distinct but compatible fluorophores allows direct spatial comparison of Aβ deposition patterns across cortical, hippocampal, and subcortical regions in the same cleared brain, fulfilling the requirement for dual-target validation of plaque distribution, size, and regional burden.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: 6E10 (1:500) and 4G8 (1:500) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Wash with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: anti-mouse IgG1 conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and anti-mouse IgG2b conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500), diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Wash with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥24 hours, protected from light)  

12 Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Mount cleared brain in glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE, oriented for dorsal or sagittal light-sheet imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use or store at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 / 4G8 + Alexa Fluor 647, Congo red + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for whole adult mouse brains (T04 tier), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for detecting sparse, deep Aβ plaques in dense AD brain tissue. It preserves Alexa Fluor 568/647 fluorescence effectively while quenching endogenous FPs (irrelevant here as labeling is antibody/dye-based). The dual-target strategy uses 6E10/4G8 (well-validated anti-Aβ monoclonal antibodies) conjugated to far-red Alexa Fluor 647 for high signal-to-background and deep imaging, complemented by Congo red—a classic amyloidophilic dye—conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 to provide orthogonal, conformation-dependent Aβ detection. This dual validation enhances specificity and enables cross-confirmation of plaque identity, essential for quantitative 3D mapping. Both fluorophores are compatible with iDISCO+ per compatibility data.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Permeabilization and Blocking  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
1.8 Rehydration: sequential incubation with 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)  
1.9 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.10 Incubation with blocking solution: PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Primary Antibody and Congo Red Co-labeling  
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody mix: 6E10 or 4G8 (1:250 in PBT + 5% serum + 0.02% NaN₃) + Congo red (0.01% wt/vol in same buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)  

3 Washing  
3.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.02% NaN₃.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Repeat washing step 3.1 two more times, changing buffer every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

4 Secondary Antibody Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500 in PBT + 5% serum + 0.02% NaN₃) + Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated streptavidin (if Congo red is biotinylated; otherwise, use pre-conjugated Congo red–Alexa Fluor 568 at 10 µg/mL).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  

5 Post-labeling Washes  
5.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.02% NaN₃.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Repeat washing step 5.1 two more times, changing buffer every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

6 Dehydration  
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Delipidation  
7.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.3 Repeat step 7.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

8 Refractive Index Matching  
8.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in light-protected container.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
9.1 Transfer cleared brain to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 (anti-Aβ) + Alexa Fluor 647, NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for whole adult mouse brains (5–12 mm scale), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for dense Aβ plaque labeling in 5XFAD models. It provides high clearing power with relatively fast processing (~1 week) and excellent compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 conjugates. Endogenous fluorescence is quenched, so target-specific immunolabeling is required. We select 6E10 (recognizes human Aβ1–16) for specific amyloid plaque detection and NeuN to delineate neuronal architecture for brain region registration and spatial context. Both primary antibodies are well-validated in iDISCO+ protocols, and their Alexa Fluor conjugates are explicitly compatible per the knowledge base.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction in aged/AD brain)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti-6E10 (1:500) and anti-NeuN (1:300) in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) donkey serum in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washes after Primary Antibody  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 two more times, changing buffer every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-mouse IgG1 Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in antibody dilution buffer (same as 5.1).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, with gentle agitation)  

8 Washes after Secondary Antibody  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 two more times, changing buffer every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer brain to glass vial filled with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage at RT, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Prior to imaging, equilibrate sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber for ≥30 minutes to minimize bubbles and RI mismatch.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
